# Oxbridge Essays

> UK's leading AI-free academic writing service trusted since 2006, offering custom essays, dissertations, PhD support, and professional editing by expert academics.

Oxbridge Essays is a UK-registered academic writing service established in 2006, specializing in plagiarism-free, human-written content for students at all levels. The platform connects students with qualified UK academics for writing, editing, and consultation services, with emphasis on personalized support and academic integrity.
